name: Abyssal Depths
description: The deepest, darkest trench in the ocean floor, where sunlight never reaches and alien leviathans roam.
visualTheme: Sunless deep-sea trenches lit only by the bioluminescent glow of floating jellyfish and deep hydrothermal vents.

history.createdWhy: Formed by a tectonic rift that sank half of the ancient southern continent.
history.builtWho: Uninhabited by humans, but deep-sea mermen built kelp shrines here.
history.majorEvents: The ancient flagship of the Smuggler King was pulled down by the Abyssal Kraken.
history.whyExists: Hosts the rarest void essence deposits and deep-sea treasures.
history.currentConflicts: The awakening of the Kraken is causing massive ocean whirlpools that destroy coastal trade.

ecosystem.weather: High crushing water pressure and total darkness

npcs.name: Captain Nautilus
dialogue: Check your air tanks, traveler. Down here, pressure is the real killer.
They say a ship of pure gold lies at the bottom of the trench.
The Kraken isn't just an animal. It's an ancient curse.

secrets.name: Sunken Galleon
secrets.description: The rotting remains of a smuggler vessel loaded with antique chests.
